description: Quick fix for an INTERNAL repo (HQ or StudioControlRoom; app repos use quick-fix): branch studio/{{slug}} from origin/main → build (local, agent from the Team: line of the intake file) → QA (local) → review (Opus + Codex) → PR, auto-merged per policy with merge-pr.js. Vars: workdir (checkout), slug, idea (intake file), repo (owner/name).

stages.run: git fetch origin && git switch -c studio/{{slug}} origin/main

stages.task: Quick fix. Implement exactly what the intake file {{idea}} asks for (only that, small and focused), using the Team role named in it; follow its rules. Run lint/typecheck/tests before finishing.

QA the quick fix {{slug}}: check the change against the acceptance criteria in {{idea}}. Follow your 'Pipeline runs' protocol (report file first). Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.qa.md ending with a line 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.
stages.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node -e "if(!/VERDICT:[s*_`]*PASS/.test(require('fs').readFileSync('{{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.qa.md','utf8')))process.exit(1)"

stages.task: Review the whole diff of branch studio/{{slug}} against origin/main in {{workdir}} for the fix described in {{idea}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.review.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

Review the whole diff of branch studio/{{slug}} against origin/main in {{workdir}} for the fix described in {{idea}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/quick-fix/{{slug}}.review-codex.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

stages.run: git add -A && git commit -m "fix: {{slug}}" && git push -u origin studio/{{slug}} && gh pr create --repo {{repo}} --fill && node "{{home}}/tools/ci/merge-pr.js" {{repo}} $(gh pr view --repo {{repo}} --json number -q .number) --wait
